concept.intent: A warm analogue pad that feels like a half-remembered tape recording: soft edges, gentle beating, never perfectly still.
concept.spectral: Two saw waves (Dual VCO) detuned by ~8 cents for slow beating; HPF Pre trims sub mud.
concept.temporal: Slow amp attack (48) and long release (58); filter envelope slower than amp so brightness blooms late.
concept.filtering: Cascade (smooth 4-pole, clean) at a muted cutoff (74), low resonance, moderate key follow.
concept.modulation: Env2 opens the filter slightly; slow LFO2 (random restart) breathes the cutoff; LFO1 random-glide feeds a small vibrato for tape-like wander.
concept.space: Classic chorus for width, then a darkish plate.
concept.architecture: Dual VCO + Cascade: the Jupiter-style VCO pair is the natural pad source, Cascade stays smooth with dense input.

description.summary: Warm / muted, swelling (pad-like) Dual VCO patch through a Cascade filter with modulation movement, Chorus (Classic) + Plate.
description.description:
Synthesis: subtractive, Dual VCO -> Cascade.
Dual VCO (Jupiter-style): VCO1 [saw] +0 st, VCO2 [saw] +0.08 st, mix 45. Detune: vco2 detuned by ~8 cents, per-voice detune (amount 25) -> chorusing/beating. Voice drift 70 introduces analog pitch instability.
Cascade filter, 4-pole 24 dB: cutoff 74 (warm / muted), resonance 12 (smooth). Env2 sweeps cutoff by 18 (peaks around 92) with a slow attack and very slow decay. LFO2 moves cutoff (6). HPF Pre at 38 trims the lows.
Amp envelope (Analogue): slow attack, sustains at 85, slow release.
Movement: LFO2 -> Cutoff (mod 2) (6); LFO1 vibrato (4).
Effects: Chorus (Classic) -> Plate.
Voicing: poly, 8 voices.
Likely use: pad / harmonic bed.
description.basis: Inferred from parameter values only. The preset was NOT listened to and no audio analysis was performed.

concept.intent: A deep, round bass that carries a track: solid fundamental, articulate attack, no fizz.
concept.spectral: Triple VCO: saw-ish osc1, slightly detuned square-ish osc2 for body, triangle-ish osc3 one octave down as sub; mixer feedback adds low-end weight.
concept.temporal: Instant attack, medium decay to a solid sustain, short release.
concept.filtering: Ladder 24 dB at a dark cutoff (52) with moderate resonance; Env2 snaps it open on each note.
concept.modulation: Env2 -> cutoff (48), mod wheel -> cutoff (30) for performance.
concept.dynamics: Velocity scales the filter envelope more than the amp.
concept.architecture: Triple VCO + Ladder: the classic Minimoog-style bass pairing.

concept.intent: Faded electric-piano-like keys: struck, warm, a little worn, sitting behind a vocal.
concept.spectral: DCO PW-reactive pulse at 30% width (hollow), saw off, a quiet sub and a hint of noise for 'air'; HPF Pre removes boom.
concept.temporal: Instant attack, medium decay to low sustain — a struck, decaying envelope. Digital envelope with curve (C) for a softer shape.
concept.filtering: Multimode LP4, cutoff 70, light resonance, strong key follow so high notes stay present.
concept.modulation: Env2 -> cutoff, velocity -> cutoff, slow LFO2 PWM for movement, random per-note pan for width.
concept.dynamics: Velocity on both envelopes and the cutoff.
concept.space: Classic chorus (Juno-like pairing) then a short dark plate.
concept.architecture: DCO + Multimode: the Juno-style signal path is ideal for polished, chorused keys.
